films.title: Jason and the Argonauts
films.description: Harryhausen's Argonaut voyage lists Euphemus among the crew — Poseidon's swift son who in the poem casts the clod that becomes Thera.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Argonaut who receives Triton/Euphemus' clod of earth and dreams the founding of Calliste (Thera) — Poseidon's son as colonial omen for Cyrene's line.

popCulture.title: Euphemus
popCulture.description: Argonaut son of Poseidon; swiftest of men and ancestor of the Battiads through the clod of Calliste.
